label: Kobo Libra Colour
description: 7-inch colour E Ink e-reader with a dual-band Wi-Fi radio that Kobo rates at 802.11ac/b/g/n on 2.4 and 5 GHz (1x1), Bluetooth for audiobooks and headphones, and a USB-C port for charging and sideloading only. It has no Ethernet socket and no dock with one, so Wi-Fi is the sole network path.
notes: Kobo's technical specs list 'Connectivity: WiFi 802.11 ac/b/g/n (i.e. dual band, 2.4 and 5 GHz), Bluetooth wireless technology, and USB-C'. One radio, 1x1, so 433M is the 80 MHz 802.11ac figure. Kobo syncs the library over HTTPS to Rakuten's store, so it needs a routable path but no inbound port. No Ethernet, no PoE, no USB NIC.
